note: Copilot & AI #3. All five screens are Copilot Studio in environment DEV (labadmin has the Copilot Studio trial licence; it builds and tests but cannot publish, so nothing is published). Prepare the day before: SharePoint indexing needs time; if search does not find 'walk-away' after a few hours use Re-index site. A screen that needs a second capture of another kind lists it under 'then'.
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT) { $env:MG_TENANT = Read-Host 'Lab tenant short name (owner types, never shown)' }
if (-not $env:PNP_CLIENT_ID) { $env:PNP_CLIENT_ID = Read-Host 'PnP app client id, MGLab PnP (owner types, never shown)' }
if (-not $env:MG_LABADMIN_UPN) { $env:MG_LABADMIN_UPN = Read-Host 'labadmin sign-in name (owner types, never shown)' }
if (-not $env:MG_SAM_UPN) { $env:MG_SAM_UPN = Read-Host 'sam.demo sign-in name (owner types, never shown)' }
Push-Location src; python -m kbpack build --out ../out/docs; python -m kbpack check ../out/docs/Policies; python -m kbpack testset --docs ../out/docs --out ../out/eval; Pop-Location
# manual (owner): as sam.demo confirm Policies opens and Restricted shows access denied; as labadmin both open

# manual (owner): in the site search as labadmin find 'walk-away' (Restricted) and 'Thursday' (Policies) before recording; if not, Site Information, View all site settings, Search and offline availability, Re-index site

# manual (owner): Copilot Studio, labadmin, DEV: share the agent for edit with sam.demo (Overview, Share) before the trimmed take; do NOT turn on Tenant graph grounding (needs a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence)

screens.name: create-agent
steps: Select environment DEV in the top bar
Create, New agent; turn the New experience toggle OFF if it is offered (say so if only the new experience exists)
Describe it: Answer Contoso employees' questions about vendor onboarding, payment terms, security requirements and renewals. Use only the knowledge sources.
Create the agent and name it Contoso Vendor Desk on the Overview page
Edit the generated instructions to: answer only from the knowledge sources; if there is no answer say so and suggest asking the Vendor Management Office
Pause on the Overview page with the instructions visible
mask: tenant name in the address bar, top bar and account menu
environment name in the address bar if it shows the tenant

screens.name: add-knowledge
steps: Open the agent Contoso Vendor Desk, Knowledge, Add knowledge
Choose SharePoint from the Featured section (not the one under Upload file)

Paste the Policies library address (tenant name masked on screen), name it Vendor policies, description: Contoso vendor onboarding, approval tiers, payment terms, security requirements, renewals and offboarding.
Add it and wait until the knowledge list shows the source as Ready
Open Settings, Generative AI: turn Web Search OFF and Use general knowledge OFF
mask: tenant name in the address bar, top bar and account menu
SharePoint address pasted in the knowledge dialog and shown in the list

screens.name: ask
steps: Open the Test your agent panel as labadmin
Type: Who has to approve a new vendor that costs 12,000 euros a year?
Expected: procurement manager for 5,000 to 24,999 euros a year, citing vendor-onboarding-policy; open the citation
If the answer is different or empty record it and say so: do not retake until it works
mask: tenant name in the address bar, top bar and account menu

screens.name: trimmed
steps: Take 1, signed in as sam.demo (no access to the Restricted library): open Contoso Vendor Desk and its Test your agent panel
Type: What discount does Contoso aim for when it negotiates a hosting renewal?
Record the real non-answer wording
Take 2, switch the sign-in to labadmin (show the sign-in switch), same question in the test panel: the answer is 12 percent
mask: tenant name in the address bar, top bar and account menu
screens.note: Two takes in one scene: sam.demo first, then labadmin. Record the sign-in switch between them.

screens.name: evaluation
steps: Open the agent, Evaluation, New evaluation, Single responses, Import
Choose out/eval/vendor-desk-testset.csv from the episode folder (11 test cases: 9 from the documents, 2 out of scope)
Review the data set; test methods General quality and Compare meaning with the default pass score
Read the Uses Copilot Credits badge, if any, before pressing Run; if it asks for a pay-as-you-go plan stop and tell the owner
Run as labadmin and show the results page with per-question pass/fail and the two out-of-scope questions; keep the real scores
mask: tenant name in the address bar, top bar and account menu
Windows user name in the file picker path

teardown: # manual (owner): Copilot Studio, delete the agent Contoso Vendor Desk (its evaluation test sets go with it)
# manual (owner): Entra admin center, delete the app registration MGLab PnP; remove browser sign-ins that are not needed
